# NovaSprout Learning

> NovaSprout Learning provides patient, one-to-one online tutoring and an optional AI study tool.

NovaSprout Learning is a brand of Karigari Home LLC. Live tutoring is available in math, science and STEM, coding and data skills, and study skills. Families and adult students can request a free demo class before deciding whether to continue.
